in_marathi.name: Budhia
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intellect, Knowledge, Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: Budhia हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Budhia is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Budh', meaning intellect, knowledge, and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Lord Budha is the planet Mercury, symbolizing intelligence, communication, and knowledge. This name is given to children believed to possess a sharp mind and the potential for great learning.
